channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from morningNewsSection1, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Trump says he may temporarily withdraw Blanche AG nomination
item.description: The development comes as two key Republicans withhold support due to concerns over the Justice Department's deal with President Trump.

item.title: Are you choosing to stay single? We want to hear from you
item.description: Solo living, travel, and dining are increasingly embraced as more adults choose to remain single. Many Americans are not interested in dating.

item.title: Trump administration requests additional $10 million for July Fourth events
item.description: Congress had set aside $150 million for 250th anniversary celebrations. The Trump-backed group organizing the state fair and fireworks is now seeking more funds.

item.title: European soccer leaders to boycott the World Cup in an unprecedented step
item.description: In an unprecedented move, European nations said they would boycott the World Cup unless FIFA reverses a controversial deal to sell minority stakes.
